name: openvdb-workspace
description: OpenVDB for JavaScript: openvdb (core), three-openvdb (three.js rendering and .wvdb loaders), webvdb (CLI).

scripts.build: npm run build -w openvdb -w three-openvdb -w webvdb
scripts.bake:examples: node ./build/webvdb/cli.mjs src/docs/examples/public/assets/bunny_cloud.vdb && node ./build/webvdb/cli.mjs src/docs/examples/public/assets/venusstatue.vdb && node ./build/webvdb/cli.mjs src/docs/examples/public/assets/utahteapot.vdb && node ./build/webvdb/cli.mjs src/docs/examples/public/assets/smoke.vdb && node ./build/webvdb/cli.mjs src/docs/examples/public/assets/sphere_points.vdb
